idle.note: the hero's cut-out bob: torso (with the harness and the crucible riding on it), head and both free arms drop 2 px and return as one rigid group; pelvis, apron, legs and feet still

move.note: a heavy plod on the protagonist's model: both legs step, six stomping steps per tile rest to rest, the near foot leading; 5 px lift; the pelvis settles 3.5 px after each landing and the torso jolts 1 px on the four full-step landings; the crucible rides the torso; the fists swing 2 px; the apron trails 2 px

lob.note: sinks 4 px and leans in, then heaves up and back: the crucible tips 22 degrees over the shoulder toward the target and the slag is lobbed (contact; the existing lob mark); both fists drive up; settles

land.note: as the slag lands far away the brute rocks forward 2 px and the emptied crucible rattles on its back (hold steps); a satisfied nod

brace.note: plants its feet and raises both iron bracers crossed in front of its face, sinking 3 px behind them; holds; lowers

scatter.note: reaches its near fist back over the shoulder into the crucible's mouth, then hurls a handful of slag at the target (contact); the torso turns into the throw

hit.note: spec hit: torso knocked 3 px back and 1 px down with a 3 degree lean back, head nods back 4 degrees, both hands trail 1 px; recovered by 0.6

death.note: sags to its knees: the pelvis drops 16 px over planted feet, the torso pitches forward 25 degrees with the crucible tipping a further 12 degrees over its head, the head bows, the fists hit the floor; terminal pose held, then the existing fade
